scope: Reanalyze exactly six frozen HUG development fits and all nine stored audit resolutions. Read existing coarse quadrature for exact coordinate correspondence only. No geometry query, optimizer, simulator, model or inference is run.
limitations: All cases are inspected development examples,not independent unseen-object validation.
Only capped saved orientation witnesses are individually listed; reported fit coverage is not exhaustive reversal coverage.
Existing query caches are required for replay but are not copied into this portable artifact.
Coordinate equality alone does not imply identical query normal,area,cell or eligibility. Fine nearest-site distances do not establish coverage or orientation validity.
No new geometry is queried; source/body/finger attribution within one anatomical proxy is not inferable from every saved witness.
SSE components are not additive soft-L1 costs. Facing robust cost is recoverable; distance and closest-point separate robust costs are not.
A coverage gap and adverse scalar tradeoff are demonstrated,not a complete correction or global infeasibility proof.
Conditional area lower bounds inherit existing numeric assumptions; anatomical areas overlap and bands are nested. No physical contact-area,failure label or lift claim is made.
